Join Us as a Clinical Research Associate (Level II) - Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to perform and coordinate all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. As a Clinical Research Associate (Level II), you'll conduct remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You will manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments (i.e., FSO, FSP, Government, etc.). Acting as a site processes specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigational sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix.
What You’ll Do:
• Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable.
• Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential
• investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Performs trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
• Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
• Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System).
• Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
• Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
• Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Synthomer is a leading supplier of high-performance, highly specialised polymers and ingredients that play vital roles in key sectors such as coatings, construction, adhesives, and health and protection - growing markets that serve billions of end users worldwide. Headquartered in London, UK and publicly listed there since 1971, we employ c.3,900 employees across our 5 innovation centres of excellence and more than 29 manufacturing sites across Europe, North America and Asia. Around 20% of our sales volumes are from new and patent protected products.
At our innovation centres of excellence in the UK, Germany, China, Malaysia and Ohio, USA we collaborate closely with our customers to develop new products and enhance existing ones tailored to their needs, with an increasing range of sustainability benefits. Since 2021, we have been proud holders of the London Stock Exchange Green Economy Mark, which recognises green technology businesses making a significant contribution to a more sustainable, low-carbon economy.

Data Scientist

Turn data into business value
Location: Home-based (Netherlands, Belgium or United Kingdom)
Type: Full-time

At Synthomer , we're investing in data, analytics, and artificial intelligence to transform how we operate and make decisions. To support this ambition, we are expanding our new Digital Centre of Excellence and are looking for a talented Data Scientist to help drive innovation across the business.
If you're passionate about solving complex problems, building predictive models, and creating tangible business impact through data, we'd love to hear from you.

Your impact
As a Data Scientist, you'll transform data into actionable insights, develop advanced analytical solutions, and help shape the next generation of digital capabilities at Synthomer . You'll work alongside Data Engineers, Data Translators, and business stakeholders to develop end-to-end solutions that create measurable value.

What you'll be doing

• Explore, prepare, and refine datasets for advanced analytics and machine learning.

• Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.

• Develop predictive and prescriptive models using statistical and machine learning techniques.

• Design feature engineering strategies to maximize model performance.

• Communicate insights through visualizations, presentations, and dashboards.

• Deploy machine learning models and monitor performance in production environments.

• Support and promote the use of AI, advanced analytics, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

What we're looking for

• 2-5 years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, or Machine Learning.

• Strong knowledge of statistics, predictive modelling, and machine learning techniques.

• Proficiency in Python, SQL, Databricks, and Apache Spark.

• Experience working with cloud-based analytics platforms.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex insights to business stakeholders.

• A curious mindset and passion for innovation and continuous learning.

Why join Synthomer ?

• Play a key role in building a world-class Digital Centre of Excellence.

• Work on high-impact AI and advanced analytics projects.

• Collaborate with global teams across manufacturing, commercial, operational, and corporate functions.

• Enjoy the flexibility of a home-based role.

• Help shape the future of digital innovation in a leading global specialty chemicals business.

Are you our new teammember! We're looking forward to hear from you!

🌍 Global Benefits Overview

• 💰 Competitive, market-aligned compensation

• 🎯 Discretionary global bonus scheme

• 📈 Discretionary Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP) - for senior positions

• 🚗 Company car or car allowance - varies by region and role

• 🩺 Healthcare - tailored to regional locations

• 👶 Parental leave and family support - maternity, paternity, adoption (aligned with regional policies)

• 🏡 Working options - flexibility

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (Stockholm)

We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Certified Weld Inspector to support the buildout of SpaceXSI's high-performance data centers. In this hands-on role, you will inspect welds on industrial piping and structural steel and keep quality moving on our next-generation AI supercomputing infrastructure.

You will work closely with welding, mechanical, structural, and operations teams to verify weld quality from construction through turnover. This is a full-time, onsite role with significant travel to SpaceXSI data center sites. This is an hourly position with overtime.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Inspect welds in progress and at completion on large-bore industrial piping and structural steel, and accept or reject them against the applicable code, welding procedure specification (WPS), and drawings.

• Interpret AWS, ASME, and project specifications against isometric, spool, structural, and arrangement drawings.

• Monitor GTAW, SMAW, FCAW, and GMAW work and confirm it is performed to the qualified welding procedure.

• Verify and document welder qualifications before a welder is released to weld on the package.

• Check joint design and preparation, fit-up, cleanliness, tack quality, preheat, interpass temperature, and interpass and final cleaning.

• Verify base metal and filler metal against the applicable specifications, including control and handling of welding consumables.

• Recommend and verify repairs, then visually inspect the completed repair before the joint is released.

• Oversee nondestructive examination and any required proof or mechanical testing, and confirm fabrication and inspection records are complete.

• Record inspection results and communicate findings to construction, welding, and engineering.

• Review contractor welding and inspection practices on site.

• Follow hot-work, LOTO, PPE, and site rules; report rejected welds, unsafe conditions, and drawing conflicts immediately.

• Support punch-list and NDE hold points through system turnover.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Current American Welding Society (AWS) Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification.

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience visually inspecting welded industrial piping and/or structural steel in the field.

• Working knowledge of ASME Section IX and AWS D1.1.

• Nondestructive testing Level II, in line with ASNT SNT-TC-1A, in visual testing (VT), magnetic particle (MT), liquid penetrant (PT), ultrasonic (UT), or phased array ultrasonic (PAUT).

• Prior experience on data center, industrial, or heavy-civil construction sites.

• Willingness to work at heights, outdoors, and on a changing data center construction site.

• Strong safety mindset and willingness to follow site procedures, including hot-work permits and inspection hold points.

• Willingness to work extended hours, nights, and weekends during critical construction windows.

• OSHA 10 or equivalent training.

• Ability to read isometric, spool, structural, and weld-map drawings and to record inspection results on a computer.

title: Chief Legal Officer (CLO)
description:
Role Summary
The Chief Legal Officer (CLO) is the senior legal executive responsible for overseeing the organization's legal strategy, governance, regulatory compliance, corporate affairs, and risk management. The CLO serves as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and executive leadership team, ensuring the organization operates within legal and regulatory frameworks while supporting business growth and strategic initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Legal Strategy & Executive Advisory

• Serve as the principal legal advisor to the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team.

• Develop and execute the organization's legal strategy in alignment with business objectives.

• Provide legal guidance on strategic initiatives, mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.

• Anticipate and mitigate legal risks associated with business operations and growth.

2. Corporate Governance

• Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.

• Advise the Board and executive leadership on fiduciary responsibilities and governance matters.

• Manage board resolutions, corporate records, and governance policies.

• Support corporate secretarial functions where applicable.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

• Oversee enterprise-wide legal and regulatory compliance programs.

• Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.

• Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.

• Develop legal risk mitigation frameworks and compliance controls.

4. Contracts & Commercial Transactions

• Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of significant commercial agreements.

• Oversee contract management processes and legal documentation standards.

• Provide legal support for strategic partnerships, vendor agreements, and customer contracts.

• Ensure contractual arrangements adequately protect organizational interests.

5. Litigation & Dispute Resolution

• Manage litigation strategy and external legal counsel relationships.

• Oversee dispute resolution, arbitration, mediation, and regulatory investigations.

• Assess litigation exposure and recommend appropriate legal actions.

• Ensure effective management of legal claims and liabilities.

6. Mergers, Acquisitions & Corporate Transactions

• Lead legal due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and investments.

• Structure transactions to minimize legal and regulatory risk.

• Manage external advisors and legal workstreams throughout transaction lifecycles.

• Support post-merger integration activities from a legal perspective.

7. Ethics, Compliance & Corporate Integrity

• Promote a culture of ethics, integrity, and compliance.

• Oversee whistleblower programs, investigations, and ethics policies.

• Ensure adherence to anti-corruption, anti-bribery, and corporate conduct standards.

• Lead internal investigations involving legal and compliance matters.

8. Legal Team Leadership

• Build and lead a high-performing legal and compliance function.

• Manage legal budgets and external counsel expenditures.

• Develop legal talent and succession planning initiatives.

• Establish legal operations processes and performance metrics.

Qualifications & Experience

• Juris Doctor (JD), LLB, or equivalent law degree.

• Licensed attorney admitted to practice in a relevant jurisdiction.

• 15+ years of progressive legal experience.

• Minimum 5+ years in a senior legal leadership role (General Counsel, CLO, Head of Legal, Legal Director).

• Experience advising executive leadership and boards of directors.

• Strong background in corporate law, governance, compliance, commercial contracts, and regulatory matters.

• Experience managing complex legal transactions and litigation.

Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Role

The Senior Product Engineer is the primary electrical design engineering presence on the production floor, bridging the gap between design intent and production execution. The role sits within Platform Engineering and is based primarily at the production site, dispositioning nonconformances and Material Review Board (MRB) actions for electrical systems and sub-assemblies, resolving design questions in real time, and closing the loop between production and design so that issues get root caused and fixed at the source. To hold that authority credibly, this role also contributes to upstream electrical design - architecture, analysis, schematics, and design reviews - so they have the depth needed to make sound disposition decisions on the floor. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical judgement in electrical and power systems engineering, the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced production environment, and the credibility to influence both design engineers and production teams. You will be expected to drive systemic improvements, cutting repeat nonconformances through changes to the design and documentation, as well as resolving individual issues.

Key Responsibilities

Production Floor Engineering Support

• Serve as the primary electrical design engineering point of contact on the production floor for assigned programs and product lines

• Represent the design authority at Material Review Board (MRB) for electrical systems, working with Quality and Manufacturing to minimise production hold time without compromising product safety and integrity

• Resolve production process-blockers, design ambiguities, and schematic/drawing interpretation issues in real time, exercising engineering judgement within defined authority boundaries

• Provide rapid-response engineering support and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to Production, Quality, and Test teams for electrical nonconformance resolution, use-as-is/rework/scrap decisions, and repair dispositions

• Identify and escalate systemic electrical design issues to core Design Engineering teams with clear problem statements, data, and recommended corrective actions

• Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations, and analysis to support MRB dispositions, deviation requests, and use-as-is justifications (e.g. power budgets, thermal derating, circuit analysis, connector/harness assessments)

Electrical Design Contribution

• Contribute to the design, development and integration of electrical systems and subsystems, maintaining the technical depth needed to hold disposition authority on the production floor

• Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations and analysis (circuit analysis, power budgets, thermal derating, EMC/EMI) to support both design decisions and MRB dispositions

• Participate in design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) and contribute to system-level trade studies

• Collaborate cross-functionally with mechanical, software, and systems engineering to integrate electrical systems into the vehicle

Design Intent Translation & Multi-Site Support

• Support the translation of electrical design intent into production-executable work across multiple product versions, configurations, and manufacturing sites

title: Software Engineer 5 – Agent Platform, AI Platform
description:
At Netflix , our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
At Netflix , we want to entertain the world, and we're constantly innovating on how entertainment is imagined, created, and delivered to a global audience. Increasingly, that innovation is powered by AI - and Netflix is making a deliberate bet to become AI Native, with AI woven into how we build products, create content, and run the company.
The Opportunity
The Agent Platform team gives Netflix engineers the infrastructure to go from zero to a production-grade AI agent without reinventing the wheel. We own the foundational building blocks the whole company builds on: the Model Gateway (unified access to external LLMs like Claude, GPT, and Gemini), the Assistance API for conversational use cases, the MCP Gateway that connects agents to Netflix 's internal systems and knowledge, our Agent SDK, and an end-to-end evaluation stack.
The work has moved well beyond chat completions. Teams across Netflix are now building agents - systems that plan, call tools, observe results, and iterate - and they depend on us for the infrastructure to do that reliably and to know whether their agents are actually any good. We're a small team with outsized leverage: what we ship becomes the foundation for AI across all of Netflix .
What you will do:

• Design, build, and operate the Agent SDK and MCP Gateway that Netflix engineers use to build, deploy, and run AI agents in production.

• Build agents and agent infrastructure across the full lifecycle - plan/act/observe loops, tool and MCP integrations, deployment, and day-2 operations.

• Make evaluation a first-class part of the platform: build the tracing, eval suites, and quality signals that let teams measure agents, catch regressions, and iterate to make them better.

• Own reliability, observability, and guardrails for non-deterministic systems running at very high scale

• Lead cross-functional initiatives with ML scientists, data scientists, product managers, and other AI Platform teams.

• Rapidly iterate with users to improve the developer experience while establishing durable foundational capabilities.

Desired Background:

• 8+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of delivering quality results.

• Hands-on experience building, deploying, operating, AND evaluating LLM agents in production - not just chat-completion apps or prototypes.

• Experience with one or more agent frameworks/SDKs (Strands, OpenAI Agents SDK, Anthropic Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, pydantic-ai, CrewAI, Google ADK) and with tool/function calling and MCP.

• Experience with LLM/agent evaluation and observability - building eval suites, tracing, and quality measurement, then iterating on results (Braintrust, LangSmith, W&B, or equivalent).

• Strong experience building SDKs and APIs for internal or external developers.

• Strong fundamentals in building and operating scalable, observable, fault-tolerant distributed systems.

• Proficiency in Python (and Python packaging tooling) plus one of Java, Go, C/C++, Rust, or Zig. Familiarity with our stack - Temporal, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes - is a plus.

• Experience with large-scale build, release, CI/CD, and observability methods.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $466,000.00 - $750,000.0

About Proof

Proof is the service-of-process marketplace modernizing how legal documents move through the real world. 10,000 law firms, from small practices to the AmLaw 100, trust us with documents that have legal consequences: a serve has to reach the right person, at the right address, under the right rules, with a court-ready affidavit proving what happened.

We're one of the fastest-growing tech enabled services companies in the U.S., and legal tech is one of the most exciting places to build software right now. We're also still early enough that you'll help shape the culture, not just inherit it. Expect real autonomy, the latest AI tools on a modern stack, plus engineers and designers who care about craft as much as you do.

The role

Due process starts at a door. Before a lawsuit can move forward, the person being sued has to be properly notified, and for thousands of cases every day, that happens through a process server using our mobile app. It's one of the most critical steps in the litigation system.

As a Product Manager on the Server Experience and Fulfilment team, you'll own the product experience that helps those servers get it right and on time, from understanding requirements and planning attempts to capturing reliable evidence of service. Your goal is to make that work easier for servers, more predictable for the law firms relying on it, and more profitable for our marketplace overall.

What you'll own

• Planning and attempts. How servers plan their day, sequence attempts, work high-volume addresses, and see which jobs are at risk before a deadline passes.

• Job requirements. Helping servers act on each job's legal requirements at the right moment, across states and counties.

• Evidence of service. The capture and verification behind every attempt: location, time, photos, eligibility checks. Raise the quality bar without slowing servers down, even with no signal.

• Fewer handoffs. Deciding what belongs in the app, what AI and automation can handle, and what still needs one of our service specialists.

• Efficient dispatch. How job offers get packaged, priced, and distributed to servers, and the product systems behind server pay.

Your team and scope

You're joining an established team that has driven some of Proof's biggest wins over the last two years. It moves quickly, ships with impact, and has built a best-in-class mobile app for process servers.

You'll report to the CPO and, as a hands-on IC, partner with a dedicated engineering squad and our design team on discovery, analysis, and delivery. You're accountable for the squad's multi-quarter roadmap. Day to day, you'll work side by side with a world-class operations team that handles server recruitment, rate negotiation, and risk and compliance, and with four other PMs who lead the law firm experience, platform automation, filing, and integrations.

What success looks like in year one

• More jobs meet their service deadlines, without more avoidable reattempts.

• Less avoidable specialist work per job, with service quality continuing to improve.

• More complete, trustworthy evidence from the field, and fewer downstream corrections caused by missing or incorrect server inputs.

• Servers find the work easier, and it shows in retention: more of our best servers stay active and take on more jobs.

Who we're hiring

You'll be a strong fit if:

• You've owned a consequential workflow from identifying the problem through launch and adoption, and can explain what you chose not to build, the tradeoffs you made, and the results.

• You've built a mobile product people depend on to do their jobs: drivers, couriers, field technicians, inspectors, or similar.

• You think in systems. You see how a change in the app ripples through dispatch, operations, and the law firm on the other end, and you design automation that holds up as volume grows.

title: Technical Program Manager, Compute Infrastructure
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Compute Infrastructure team runs the GPU fleet and large-scale compute clusters that serve the models backing ChatGPT and the API, while also supporting training workloads for our next generation of models. We provide a unified platform for OpenAI teams to run production Applied AI and Research training workloads.

Our work spans cloud providers, bare metal infrastructure, data centers, and the foundational services that make compute usable. We partner across Engineering, Research, Product, Capacity Planning, Finance, and Data Center Infrastructure to bring new capacity online and support OpenAI’s growing compute needs.

We seek to learn from deployment and distribute the benefits of AI, while ensuring that this powerful tool is used responsibly and safely. Safety is more important to us than unfettered growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Technical Program Manager for Compute Infrastructure, you will own the supply signal for all GPUs entering our fleet: a reliable view of what capacity is arriving, where and when it will arrive, and when it is expected to become usable. You will own the roadmap, requirements, delivery, and adoption of the tools, data, and platform behind that signal, partnering with Engineering to build systems that support planning and execution across OpenAI.

You will also lead programs that turn incoming supply into usable compute. Working across cloud providers, Data Center Infrastructure, and compute engineering teams, you will connect physical site readiness with the CPU, storage, network, GPU, and foundational services required to bring new sites and clusters online.

You will be part of an engineer-first TPM team, managing a broad portfolio of infrastructure programs and making dependencies, risks, and decisions clear from working teams through leadership. Your work will help teams plan with confidence, respond to supply changes, and deliver capacity on time.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Own the GPU supply signal across the fleet. Maintain a trusted view of incoming capacity across providers, sites, and clusters, including quantities, delivery forecasts, acceptance and readiness milestones, and expected dates for production use. Make changes and their downstream effects visible.

- Build and scale the tools, data, and platform behind that signal. Own the roadmap, requirements, delivery, and adoption, partnering with Engineering on data models, integrations, quality checks, and planning workflows. Serve Product TPMs, Capacity TPMs, and Compute TPMs, alongside Finance, Accounting, leadership, Engineering, and Research.

- Connect supply with capacity planning. Partner with Capacity Planning on supply and demand management, allocation planning, and scenario analysis. Ensure plans reflect current supply forecasts, infrastructure constraints, and the effects of early or late deliveries.

- Coordinate physical readiness for new capacity. Work closely with Data Center Infrastructure and cloud service providers to align ready-for-service dates, site construction, power and cooling readiness, supply-chain convergence, equipment delivery, and commissioning. Track dependencies and drive resolution of gaps that threaten deployment.

- Lead logical readiness across infrastructure resources. Coordinate CPU, storage, network, GPU, Kubernetes, and dependent compute foundation services so new clusters can support their intended workloads. Make clear which missing services or resources could delay GPU use.

- Drive deployment across cloud and bare metal environments. Lead integrated plans across AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI, and other infrastructure partners, accounting for provider-specific dependencies while establishing consistent readiness criteria and handoffs.

- Establish Delivery Scorecards for cloud providers and internal infrastructure teams. Track delivery commitments, forecast changes, actual delivery, readiness milestones, and time to usable capacity. Use these scorecards to identify recurring gaps,

title: Senior Manager, Deal Desk - North America
description:
If you are looking for a meaningful career where people work and act with passion, rethink the existing and always strive to find the best solution - you have come to the right place. We develop future technologies to relentlessly make supply chains better.
We are a leader in supply chain software solutions, helping organizations streamline operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency.
The Senior Manager, Deal Desk - North America serves as the commercial quarterback for strategic, complex and non-standard North America transactions and helps establish the global Deal Desk operating model. The role partners with Sales from early deal strategy through signature and booking readiness to structure commercially viable transactions, drive timely decisions and ensure deals are properly approved, documented and operationally executable.
This is a hands-on player-coach role without direct reports. In addition to leading North America transactions, the Senior Manager helps establish global intake, governance, service standards and execution practices, and supports APAC transactions as required. As the function scales, the role is expected to assume leadership of regional Deal Desk resources.
What a day in the life looks like:

• Serve as the primary Deal Desk partner for North America Sales, leading complex and strategic transactions while advising on deal structure, pricing, commercial terms, negotiations, and financial analysis.

• Drive cross-functional deal execution by partnering with Sales, Finance, Legal, Accounting, Tax, Product, Professional Services, Security, and Operations to resolve issues and ensure timely approvals.

• Draft, negotiate, and manage commercial agreements, ensuring compliance with company policies and readiness for booking, billing, revenue recognition, and delivery requirements.

• Oversee contract lifecycle management, including documentation, approvals, execution, and alignment with CRM/CPQ systems and approved deal structures.

• Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls, reporting, and automation while analyzing deal trends to enhance commercial effectiveness and scalability.

• Provide coaching, cross-regional support, and leadership within a fast-paced global environment, including quarter-end and multi-time-zone coverage.

What you bring to the team:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 8+ years of experience in Deal Desk, commercial finance, revenue operations, sales operations, pricing, or a related function.

• Proven experience structuring and executing complex enterprise software, SaaS, or technology transactions.

• Strong commercial, financial, and contractual acumen, including pricing, profitability, revenue recognition, and non-standard deal analysis.

• Experience partnering across functions to drive deal execution, process improvements, governance, and approval workflows.

• Proficiency with Salesforce and CPQ platforms; CLM and ERP experience is a plus.

• Excellent negotiation, communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills, with the ability to influence decisions in a fast-paced environment.

​
Base salary: $144,530.00 USD. Plus bonus opportunities based on experience, performance, and market factors.
Why join us?

At Infios , we're not just looking for employees; we're looking for partners in innovation, growth, and purpose. Meeting you where you are to create the future you need is at the core of who we are and what we do. Whether you're at the beginning of your career or a seasoned expert, we meet you on your journey, equipping you with the tools and opportunities to build the future you envision. Together, we will relentlessly work toward one common goal - making supply chains better.

We believe the future is better when supply chains work better.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in the workplace.

title: Medizinische Fachangestellte (m/w/d)
description:
IHR START BEI PRAXISEINS.

Keine Lust mehr auf einen stressigen Praxisalltag und mangelnde Wertschätzung? Es ist Zeit für die Praxis der Zukunft, werden Sie Teil von PraxisEins!

Sie wollen endlich in einem Umfeld arbeiten, das Sie wertschätzt, Stress so gering wie möglich hält, technisch stets modernisiert wird und Ihnen angenehme Arbeitszeiten ermöglicht? Ein Traum? Falsch! Bei uns ist das möglich!

Werden Sie Teil einer solchen Praxis!

Wir suchen eine ambitionierte Medizinische Fachangestellte (m/w/d) für unser Hausarztzentrum

WAS WIR IHNEN BIETEN

- Wertschätzung

- Offene Feedback-Kultur (Wichtigste Regel: Wir reden miteinander und nicht übereinander)

- Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung

- 28-30 Urlaubstage

- Umfangreiche fachliche sowie überfachliche Weiterbildungen

- Raum für Kreativität und Eigeninitiative

- Zusammenarbeit mit jungem Management

- Moderne, attraktive Praxis, die zum Austausch einlädt und das Wohlbefinden fördert

- Junges, dynamisches Team, das etwas bewegen will

IHRE AUFGABEN

- Sie unterstützen im Praxisalltag am Empfang, im Labor und bei der Behandlung

- Sie unterstützen bei Dokumentation und Abrechnung (EBM, GoÄ)

- Sie unterstützen das Recall-Management und Patiententelefon

- Sie unterstützen beim Beschaffungsmanagement

- (falls NäPa/Verah/Eva) Sie betreuen Ihre Patienten durch regelmäßige Hausbesuche und Heimbesuche

IHR PROFIL

Bei uns zählen Charakter und Menschlichkeit mehr als Skills & Erfahrung. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Punkte des Anforderungsprofils erfüllen, bitten wir Sie, uns Ihre Bewerbung zu senden. Schließlich können wir alles beibringen, wenn der Charakter und die Einstellung stimmt!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringen Sie idealerweise mit:

- Lebensfrohe und offene Natur

- Verantwortungsbewusstes und respektvolles Auftreten

- Hohes Maß an Selbstorganisation und Zuverlässigkeit

- Berufserfahrung in einer Praxis im hausärztlichen Bereich oder als MFA bzw. in der Pflege

- Leichtigkeit im Umgang mit digitalen Programmen

- Deutschkenntnisse auf sehr gutem Niveau

- (Von Vorteil) abgeschlossene NäPa/Eva/Verah Ausbildung

ÜBER PRAXISEINS

PraxisEins ist ein staatlich unterstützter Gesundheitsversorger mit einem Fokus auf den Bereichen der hausärztlichen Versorgung, Diabetologie und Schmerztherapie.

UNSERE MISSION

Versorgung sichern - Qualitätsmedizin gewährleisten. Als PraxisEins wollen wir die Primärversorgung zukunftsfähig machen - mit digitaler Unterstützung, klaren Prozessen und einem Umfeld, in dem Ärztinnen und Ärzte Medizin wieder mit Freude ausüben können!

PraxisEins ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert und Vielfalt schätzt. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerbungen und bearbeiten diese völlig unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religionszugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand oder Behindertenstatus. Zur besseren Lesbarkeit wird in dieser Stellenanzeige das generische Maskulinum verwendet.

title: Sr. Implementation Program Manager - Utah
description:
Job Description:
Senior Implementation Program Manager - Utah

About the Role
Packsize is seeking a Senior Implementation Program Manager to lead complex customer implementations from post-sale kickoff through go-live, stabilization, and formal handoff. This role combines disciplined program management with customer success leadership, ensuring solutions are delivered on time and within budget while preparing customer teams to operate, adopt, and realize sustained value.
What You’ll Do
Lead the customer implementation

• Own customer-facing implementation leadership from kickoff through formal closeout and handoff, adapting governance for complex, multi-site, enterprise, or high-risk deployments.

• Translate the sold solution and customer requirements into an outcomes-based plan with clear scope, milestones, owners, decision rights, dependencies, and completion criteria.

• Build trusted relationships with customer leaders and cross-functional teams, aligning them around critical dates, readiness expectations, decisions, and implementation outcomes.
Drive program execution and risk management

• Coordinate with Sales, engineering, Service, Operations, and other partners to confirm requirements and maintain the Implementation Specification Document and integrated implementation plan.

• Manage schedules, budgets, costs, customer prerequisites, and cross-functional commitments across multiple concurrent implementations.

• Maintain the RAID log, remove roadblocks, and escalate material scope, schedule, technical, customer, or commercial risks with clear recommendations.
Build readiness, adoption, and go-live success

• Drive customer readiness across facilities, workflows, staffing, training, materials, systems, and operational support using clear completion criteria.

• Lead onboarding, stakeholder alignment, communications, training coordination, and practical change management while surfacing adoption risks early.

• Coordinate go/no-go readiness reviews, Customer Acceptance Testing, and go-live execution with transparent risks, owners, and contingency plans.

• Lead early-life stabilization and confirm readiness, acceptance, training, and early-adoption outcomes before implementation closeout.
Close, hand off, and improve

• Execute a checklist-based handoff documenting the operating state, adoption baseline, open items, risks, named owners, and next-step success plan for ongoing technical and commercial teams.

• Provide concise status, decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations to customers and Packsize leaders, using influence to align teams and move issues forward.

• Complete closeout artifacts and after-action reviews, using root-cause analysis to improve implementation practices, governance, and customer experience.

How Success Will Be Measured

•
Reliable execution: Milestones, schedule, budget, risks, and escalations are managed effectively.

•
Customer readiness and adoption: People, processes, facilities, systems, and training are ready for launch and early use.

•
Successful go-live: Customer acceptance is achieved, operations stabilize, and critical launch issues are closed.

•
Quality handoff and improvement: Open items and ownership are clearly transferred, with lessons applied to future implementations.

Measures may be tailored to the scope and complexity of the assigned implementation portfolio.
What You'll Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Five or more years of project or program management experience leading complex customer-facing implementations and multiple concurrent priorities.

• Demonstrated customer and change leadership, including the ability to build trust, navigate conflict, and influence senior stakeholders and matrixed teams.

• Strong technical acumen across hardware, software, integrations, and customer operations, with the curiosity to learn complex solutions quickly.

• Clear executive communication and sound

title: VP of Business Development, National Payers
description:
Everlywell is a digital health company pioneering the next generation of biomarker intelligence-combining AI-powered technology with human insight to deliver personalized, actionable health answers. We transform complex biomarker data into life-changing insights-seamlessly integrating advanced diagnostics, virtual care, and patient engagement to reshape how and where health happens.

Over the past decade, Everlywell has delivered close to 1 billion personalized health insights, transforming care for 60 million people and powering hundreds of enterprise partners. In 2025, an estimated 1 in 94 U.S. adults received an Everlywell test, solidifying our spot as the #1 at-home testing company in the country. Fueled by AI and built for scale, we’re breaking down barriers, closing care gaps, and unlocking a more connected healthcare experience that is smarter, faster, and more personalized.

We are hiring a VP of Business Development, National Payers to drive Everlywell 's revenue growth with the largest national health plans, such as UnitedHealthcare, Elevance Health, Humana, Aetna/CVS Health, Cigna, and Centene. Reporting directly to the Chief Commercial Officer, this senior, quota-carrying role owns three things: winning new logos, expanding into new markets, and growing overall revenue with existing national payer clients - across Medicare Advantage, ACA, commercial, and Medicaid lines of business.

You'll navigate large, matrixed organizations, build enterprise-level relationships, and turn first programs into multi-line, multi-market partnerships. You'll work hand in hand with Account Management: they own day-to-day relationships, delivery, and renewals; you lead new opportunities, enterprise expansion deals, and new-market entry within those clients, with shared account plans and shared growth goals.

Responsibilities:

• Own an annual growth quota for national payers covering new-logo wins, new-market expansion, and revenue growth with existing clients

• Build, qualify, and close pipeline through prospecting, your industry network, referrals, and events

• Identify and win expansion opportunities with existing national payer clients - new lines of business, business units, states and markets, programs, and populations

• Partner with Account Management on joint account plans for existing clients: align on growth targets, executive relationships, and who leads each opportunity, and keep handoffs seamless

• Develop enterprise account strategies for each target payer: map business units, budget owners, decision process, and procurement path

• Lead complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles with payer executives across quality and Star Ratings, population health, care management, product, network, and procurement/vendor management

• Craft tailored value propositions for each line of business - Medicare Advantage, ACA, commercial/fully insured, and Medicaid - and for enterprise-wide agreements

• Develop strong pitch materials, proposals, RFP responses, and business cases in partnership with Marketing

• Partner with Pricing, Finance, and Legal/Contracting to structure enterprise deals (e.g., master agreements, multi-line statements of work) and own development of statements of work and contracts

• Keep HubSpot current and accurate; forecast monthly, quarterly, and annual bookings to the Chief Commercial Officer

• Maintain in-depth knowledge of national payer priorities, market conditions, competitors, and market offerings

• Represent Everlywell at conferences, seminars, webinars, and other external-facing events

• Bring the voice of the market into product and commercial roadmaps

• Report on business development metrics and KPIs (pipeline coverage, win rate, cycle time, new-logo and expansion bookings)

Who You Are / Job Requirements:

• 10+ years of enterprise business development or sales experience selling to health plans

• Proven record of winning new logos and growing business with major national health plans

title: Account Manager (Remote, US, Remote)
description:
About the role
Computacenter is a leading independent technology and services provider, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations globally. We are a responsible business that believes in winning together for our people and our planet.
We build unrivalled value for our customers over the long-term, helping them to achieve their goals.
It’s one of the reasons that we’re trusted by some of the world’s greatest organizations.
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven outside sales Account Associate to join our enterprise sales team. This role is responsible for assisting with developing and managing strategic relationships with some of the largest and most notable companies in the world, driving revenue growth through the sale of IT products and services.
Annual compensation : $120K - $150K USD + Commision
What you’ll be doing

• Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities within assigned territory.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers (CIOs, CTOs, IT Directors) and OEM partners.

• Present and demonstrate solutions that address client needs across infrastructure, networking, datacenter, cloud, cybersecurity, and managed services.

• Collaborate with internal teams (pre-sales, marketing, and support) to deliver tailored solutions and proposals.

• Manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting to negotiation and closing.

• Meet and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.

• Maintain accurate records of sales activities and pipeline in CRM systems.

What you have

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, or related field (MBA a plus).

• 3+ years of experience in IT sales, with a proven track record of selling to large companies.

• Solid understanding of enterprise IT environments and buying cycles.

• Strong knowledge of servers, storage, networking, enterprise applications, cloud platforms, and IT services.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

• Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and able to work independently and collaboratively.

• Ability to travel to meetings. Must have a valid Driver’s License.

• Legal authorization to work in the United States.

What you can expect
There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.
About us
Computacenter is a leading independent technology partner, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. We help our world-renowned customers to source, transform, and manage their IT infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling users and their business. We’re a public company quoted on the London FTSE 250 (CCC.L) and employ over 21,000 people worldwide. In the US, we support some of the country’s best-known businesses with regional hubs in San Francisco and Irvine, CA; Norcross, GA; Plano, TX; and New York City; and Integration Centers in Silicon Valley and Atlanta.
